title: Output after an encoded gate list
statement: Let a Boolean gate be labelled AND, OR, or NOT and have a finite list of natural-number input indices. Encode a natural number $k$ as $k$ copies of $1$ followed by $0$, encode a list by placing $1$ before each encoded entry and ending with $0$, and encode each gate by its two-bit label followed by the encoding of its input-index list. For every finite list of such gates and every finite bit string $r$, the bit transducer that scans these encodings, suppressing output until it reaches the suffix, outputs exactly $r$ when started in its gate-processing state and given the encoded gate list followed by $r$.
hypotheses_covered: The suffix is a finite bit string.
